title: For Trump, Secret Flight Was a Stunning Ruse. For Putin, ‘a Regular Tuesday.’
summary_full: President Trump’s Air Force One subterfuge pales in comparison to the secrecy surrounding Russia’s president, whose fixation on security has reached new heights in recent years.
